Publishes copy-control globals: dword_5DD838 = a8, dword_5DD834 = a7, dword_5DD840 = a8*a7. Scans the run-length pattern array (a9) to locate the current segment, then runs the main copy loop while dword_5DD840 > 0, copying v20 elements (2*v20 bytes) per segment via qmemcpy, advancing cursors by 2*v20 or rewinding by the strides at segment boundaries, toggling the direction flag dword_5DD83C per segment. Returns an uninitialized stack slot.
